programme.title: On the Case: Bound by the Truth
programme.desc: When a retired professor is found murdered, police must figure out whether the victim's son and daughter in law were eyewitnesses or the killers.

programme.title: On the Case: A Window to Murder
programme.desc: A valiant teenager's dying act helps police solve the mystery behind her murder

programme.title: On the Case: A Mother's Nightmare
programme.desc: A young boy is murdered in his bed in the middle of the night. Police suspect the child's mother. Over the next 9 years there will be accusations, a confession and a conviction but will justice be served?

programme.title: On the Case: Murder by the Numbers?
programme.desc: A small town is outraged when its unofficial mayor is the victim of a vicious attack at work. The police investigation uncovers a number of possible suspects and a confusing trail of evidence but will it lead them to the person who committed the crime?

programme.title: On the Case: Vanished in the Night
programme.desc: When 20 year old Lynsie Ekelund suddenly goes missing in the dead of night, it leaves her mother scrambling for answers.

programme.title: On the Case: Tip 1960
programme.desc: 19 year old Katie Poirier was working the night shift at a Convenience store when she was violently kidnapped. The abduction was captured on videotape but the images were not clear enough to identify her attacker.

programme.title: On the Case: Hidden by Lies
programme.desc: After a college student is found stabbed to death in her off-campus apartment, it may take a second murder to solve her case.

programme.title: On the Case: Deadly Predator
programme.desc: A sexual predator viciously murders a 16 year old girl. Can investigators catch him before he kills again?

programme.title: On the Case: The Day After Christmas
programme.desc: A man and his girlfriend are attacked by a mysterious intruder in their home. Despite near fatal wounds, she survives and helps investigators solve the crime.

programme.title: On the Case: Same Crime Next Year
programme.desc: A teenager is found murdered on the weekend of the Daytona 500 motor race in Daytona Beach, Florida. Then, one year later, police are called to the scene of a nearly identical crime.

programme.title: On the Case: Nine Days of Terror
programme.desc: When a young college student disappears out of a mall parking lot, police find themselves in a race against time to find her before it is too late.

programme.title: On the Case: Veil of Suspicion
programme.desc: A beloved husband and father is found executed in front of his home.

programme.title: On the Case: A Hole in their Hearts
programme.desc: A mother of three disappears from her office in broad daylight, and the case remains open for eight years until two farmers unearth a clue.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder in Room 205
programme.desc: A young woman's journey to a new life comes to a savage end in a roadside motel.

programme.title: On the Case: Half Way Home
programme.desc: The discovery of a woman's body inside an abandoned trailer leads to a 28-year search for the person responsible for her beating death.

programme.title: On the Case: 22 Hours of Terror
programme.desc: A 12-year-old girl is kidnapped during a home invasion, and police frantically search for her and her abductor. Paula Zahn explores the case.

programme.title: On the Case: From Dusk to Darkness
programme.desc: After a 10-year-old girl mysteriously disappears, her family and the police undergo a tormenting journey to find a lead.

programme.title: On the Case: A Stranger Among Us
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Velda Rumfelt's disappearance in Brentwood, Missouri, in 1977 marked the beginning of a tragic, decades long mystery.

programme.title: On the Case: This is for Her
programme.desc: A deadly home invasion leaves a father of three dead. Why was the victim's wife, the only eyewitness to the crime left alive?

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Crash Landing
programme.desc: Just months from retiring, Electra captain Ray Weber leads his crew on a multi-trip mission that requires landing on a rough ice strip on a remote lake.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Checkflight
programme.desc: Joe leaves to undergo medical tests at the Mayo Clinic in Phoenix, Arizona. Jeff and Sam stress over their DC-3 checkflights and Joe celebrates turning 70-his way.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: British Invasion
programme.desc: oe and Mikey head off to Coventry, England to navigate the potential purchase of an Electra turboprop to add to Buffalo's fleet of fire-fighting tanker planes.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Transatlantic Crossing
programme.desc: The Turkey crew makes the critical jump over the North Atlantic. But en route to Portugal, one crew is forced to turn back.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Strip
programme.desc: Mechanic Jimmy is sent to a northern mining camp to create an ice landing strip on a remote lake where AJ will have to land a DC-3 and the much bigger C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Big Deal
programme.desc: When a power failure leaves Rankin Inlet exposed to the brutal northern elements, captain Justin races to deliver an emergency generator. Ramp hand Jeremy tries to move ahead of co-worker Audrey by training a new hire from India to replace him.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Jam
programme.desc: After taking command of an intense airlift, and dealing with the ugliest Electra load he's ever seen, Scott takes a scary fall on the icy tarmac.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Suspension
programme.desc: A furious Joe fights against a federal suspension that will prevent him from carrying passengers for the first time in 20 years. It's also a setback for Jeremy and the other rampies, which takes a turn for the worse with an unexpected injury.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Storm
programme.desc: Buffalo's Electra aircraft is hammered by rough winds up the Mackenzie Valley. In Hay River, a rookie crew faces the worst ice storm in years and one rampie has a tough go trying to fit in at Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Expect the Unexpected
programme.desc: Engine troubles on the C-46 during the valley run force Devan to shut down an engine. High winds wreak havoc for Devan and his crew on another C-46 mission to help clean up an oil spill in the Northwest Territories.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Cold Start
programme.desc: Mikey links up with Chris Hadfield aboard the International Space Station. Problems mount while trying to get a frozen DC-4 airborne. A landing gear collapse on the runway sends the entire crew scrambling.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: The River Lift
programme.desc: A vital ferry link is down, so Buffalo mounts an all-out campaign to airlift 100,000lbs of essential goods across the Mackenzie River.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Very Buffalo Christmas
programme.desc: A week before Christmas, Buffalo agrees to lend a hand to an RCMP initiative to fly toys to isolated communities in the north. But a series of problems with the Electra leave the company in a jam.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Air Show
programme.desc: Joe flies with the Snowbirds during the Hamilton air show and later teaches Mikey to fly. A surprise departure shakes up Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Sunk
programme.desc: Joe and Mikey hire a helicopter for a salvage mission to retrieve the rare tailpiece from a Lockheed 10-A that crashed in the Yellowknife woods forty years ago.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Breakdown
programme.desc: Co-pilot Graeme's fumbles his Electra training landings. Chris stresses over his C-46 check ride. Adam rescues a stranded C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: 40/40/40
programme.desc: Rookie co-pilot Scott faces his worst nightmare when a faltering Curtiss C-46 Commando engine and low fog force a scary landing.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Aussie Ace
programme.desc: The Electra returns from repairs and the crew takes it right back to the ice strip that it set off from before the crash landing last year. Tyler works up the courage to confront Joe about a big decision. A hotshot Australian pilot tries to earn a job.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: The Crash
programme.desc: After thousands of hours of painstaking preparation and dangerous flying, a terrible accident devastates the waterbomber crew in Turkey - and everyone at Buffalo.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Got Balls
programme.desc: After returning to LA, Ton & Allen head deep into hostile auction hunter territory and butt heads with a familiar old foe! They discover a driving range golf ball picker vehicle and one of the most accurate rifles ever made!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Ton and Allen duke it out with a local thrift store gang at a Brooklyn storage auction. The guys discover a classic arcade redemption game and a mid-century water cannon designed to fight towering infernos!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Rodeo Ton
programme.desc: 1970s El Toro mechanical bull used to train bull riders; silver WWII era banjo; a collection of 1800s handcrafted hunting duck decoys.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Top Gun Ton
programme.desc: Scale RC Viper FanJet aircraft with a potent jet engine; 1920s Gundlach Korona large format field camera used for photography expeditions. Ton pilots a plane, but crashes and burns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fake Punt Payoff
programme.desc: Ton and Allen contend with a large crowd of inexperienced auction-buyers at a huge storage container auction in Pasadena. They find a small fleet of Segway personal transporters and an enormous custom-made shotgun.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Knuckle Dust
programme.desc: 1870s French Jarre Dolne Knuckle Duster revolver-knife-brass knuckle combo, a rare original George Rodrigue "Blue Dog" screenprint and a 1980 autographed Raging Bull movie poster.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hula Moola
programme.desc: Ton and Allen jet to the Hawaiian islands where they're joined by a feisty new female assistant! The team uncovers a pair of James Bond-style gadgets designed for high-speed underwater travel and a vintage sled.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sidecar Surprise
programme.desc: An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Everything's Bigger in Texas
programme.desc: Winchester 1886 rifle invented to kill buffalo; collection of 1950s electric Slot Cars.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Drumming Up Cash
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face some silent but deadly competition at an auction in nearby Glendale. They discover a Zildjian brand percussion cymbal from the 1940's and a pyrotechnics control board designed for large-scale fireworks displays!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Hot Commodity
programme.desc: Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hot Wheels
programme.desc: '70s sand rail dune racer with rally hemi heads; 1965 replica Mustang pool table; off-road racing gear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ice, Ice, Baby
programme.desc: Ton and Allen have to get aggressive when they encounter a towering opponent with a mountain of cash. The guys uncover a vintage ice resurfacing machine and an Olympic biathlon rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Got a Gun
programme.desc: In the affluent area of Mission Hills, CA, Allen and Ton pick up an estate unit that contains a minibike, a Depression-era slot machine and an 1871 Colt revolver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Smoking Ton
programme.desc: WW2 Stuart M3 tank barrel and heavy duty tank treads; rare, collectors' 1890 silver inlayed humidor; high-end industrial meat slicer in the ultimate restaurant unit.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sink or Swim
programme.desc: 1905 Hand-crank Thomas Edison gramophone with cylindrical records; a discontinued Addictor 190 Mini Boat; a rare 1897 Regina music box.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Jersey Score
programme.desc: Ton & Allen attend a silent auction in NJ, but that doesn't stop the local buyers from letting them know they're not welcome! They uncover a skeet throwing machine from the 1960's & a vintage vehicle with some real horsepower!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Big Score
programme.desc: At a climate-controlled storage facility in downtown L.A., Allen and Ton's locker wins score them an antique cash register and a German H&K pistol prized by collectors.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Battle Bought
programme.desc: Mint 1800s French "Harmonica Pistol" and a collection of '90s remote controlled combat robots.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Auction Hunters, Ink.
programme.desc: Autographed 1960s Bob Shaw Swing Gate tattoo machine; Terry Ives competition 22hp chainsaw; six foot chainsaw-carved cedar bear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Dallas Mavericks
programme.desc: Military-grade Tomahawk cruise missile jet engine; century-old handcrafted wild west cowboy saddle; 1960s high roller's gold money.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Choo-Choo, Cha-Ching!
programme.desc: Ton and Allen get a surprise second chance after nearly getting shut out in the small town of Palmer. They uncover a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960's and a pre-WWI Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Shuffle
programme.desc: Ton and Allen teach a cocky new auction hunter a lesson. They spot a 1940's-era shuffleboard table and uncover an early hot rod made from the fuel tank of a WWII fighter plane!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Home on the Gun Range
programme.desc: Barely making it to an auction in Corona, CA, Allen and Ton buy an overstuffed unit and find an antique crossbow, a rare 10-gauge Winchester shotgun and a 1940s Kiss-o-Meter.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gold 'n' Gloves
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes toe-to-toe with Ton's evil twin! They find a medieval catapult designed for storming castles and Ton uncovers a hidden collection of gold bars worth thousands of dollars!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Little-Ton Jones
programme.desc: Allen & Ton try to get the inside scoop on their competition by chatting up local auction buyers. The guys find some heavy gold-mining machinery from the 1950s & an amateur rocket that can travel faster than the speed of sound!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Great American Cashtime
programme.desc: Rare 1950s Master Pitch baseball machine; 1980s Jaws of Life tool used by rescuers to pry open cars.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Mr. Haff Goes to Washington
programme.desc: Ton and Allen invade the Nation's capital, but meet strong resistance from local bidders. The guys uncover a Civil War era black powder revolver and a stash of South African gold coins!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Bowling Pin Payday
programme.desc: Allen & Ton visit Ton's old stompin' ground and go head-to-head with a trash-talking auction buyer. They uncover a 19th century rifle with a matching cutlass bayonet and a mechanical bowling pinsetter from the early 1960's!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead
programme.desc: A custom-built shark cage; 1900s pathologist's dissection toolkit; 1940s embalming pump and one of the first electric bone saws.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Money Makin' Monster Machines
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes on the attack & ends up on a collision course with a hardened veteran auction buyer. They uncover a collection of speedy off-road vehicles and some hardcore heavy metal from the turn-of the-century!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Miami Heat
programme.desc: All-terrain Air Commander Hovercraft, a 1970s NASA countdown clock and a one-of-a-kind 1960s Delta Relay rocket.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Weapons of Past Destruction
programme.desc: Knowing that Hollywood auctions are hit-and-miss, Allen and Ton buy inexpensive lockers that contain a polygraph machine, a samurai sword and a pair of Civil War shotguns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Early Bird Special
programme.desc: Vintage Shooting Star carnival game; professional Mixed Martial Arts octagon fighting cage.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Big Easy Money
programme.desc: Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Voodoo Moola
programme.desc: Allen & Ton hit a storage auction in Louisiana's Capitol City and quickly find themselves in trouble with the law! The guys uncover a pair of racing lawnmowers and then stumble on an antique barber chair from the early 1900s!

programme.title: Meet Me Under the Mistletoe
programme.desc: To rivaliserende ejendomsmæglere er tvunget til at arbejde sammen for at sælge et særligt hus, der ejes af en kendt botaniker og misteltenavler, lige op til jul.

programme.title: A Dash of Christmas
programme.desc: Megan har fundet sit drømmejob i en madvirksomhed, men først må hun lære at bage. Da hun rekrutterer en flot bager til at hjælpe sig, ender hun uforvarende med at deltage i en julebagekonkurrence.

programme.title: Hotel for the Holidays
programme.desc: Mens hoteldirektør Georgia navigerer i romantiske forviklinger med kokken og en flot prins, får vi et glimt af de andre gæsters og personalets liv på Hotel Maison i New York.

programme.title: En ny chance til jul
programme.desc: En kvinde rejser et år tilbage i tiden. Tilbage til julen før hendes forlovelse gik i stykker, hvor hun vil forsøge at reparere, det der gik galt. Hun opdager at det er måske en større opgave end hun troede.

programme.title: A Wish for Christmas
programme.desc: Sara foretrækker at sidde på sidelinjen på arbejdet, men da hendes juleidé bliver stjålet, ønsker hun, at hun endelig får mod til at stå op for sig selv. Kan julemanden opfylde hendes ønske?

programme.title: Christmas Party Crashers
programme.desc: Da to svindlere mødes efter at have crashet den samme millionærs julefrokost, bliver de enige om at samarbejde – uvidende om, at de snart finder noget, der er vigtigere end rigdom og berømmelse: ægte kærlighed.

programme.title: The Jingle Bell Jubilee
programme.desc: En kommunaldirektør får hjælp af sin barndomsven til at arrangere byens julevelgørenhedsarrangement, og samtidigt forsøger hun at splejse ham sammen med sin nære veninde.

programme.title: Christmas Unfiltered
programme.desc: Beckys juleønske er, at hendes familie for én gangs skyld vil høre på hende. Men så begynder alle hendes tanker og frustrationer at vælte ud, da hun ufrivilligt begynder at fortælle alle, hvad hun virkelig tænker.

programme.title: The Christmas Spirit
programme.desc: Charlotte ender i koma efter en ulykke, men hendes sjæl er vågen. Inden en afstemning om et ejendomsprojekt skal hun få sin by og bygherren til at skifte mening, mens ingen kan se eller høre hende.

programme.title: A Christmas Blessing
programme.desc: Mandy sælger sin afdøde tantes hjælpeorganisation til den tilstødende virksomhedsejer Adam. Men Otto, som har været frivillig på stedet, vil gerne afholde en sidste velgørende julemiddag.

programme.title: A Christmas... Present
programme.desc: Maggie fejrer jul med sin bror Paul og hans datter, efter at hans kone døde for nylig. Det får hende til at indse, hvad der mangler i hendes liv.

programme.title: NCIS: Interne affærer
programme.desc: Da liget af våbenhandleren La Grenouille dukker op, efterforsker FBI NCIS-teamet for mordet på ham, og Jenny Shepard bliver den hovedmistænkte.

programme.title: NCIS: I krigszonen
programme.desc: Da et morterangreb i Bagdad ender som en mordefterforskning, sendes to medlemmer af NCIS-teamet til Irak for at opklare sagen.

programme.title: NCIS: Rekyl
programme.desc: Zivas undercoveropgave tager en chokerende og dødelig drejning, da en seriemorder, hun har sporet, mistænker hende.

programme.title: NCIS: Genkendt
programme.desc: Jimmy Palmer bliver mål for en mystisk morder, som kun han kan genkende.

programme.title: NCIS: Dommedag, Del I
programme.desc: Hele teamets skæbne hænger i en tynd tråd, da de jagter en, der myrdede en af deres egne.

programme.title: NCIS: Dommedag, Del II
programme.desc: Hele teamets skæbne hænger i en tynd tråd, da de jagter en, der myrdede en af deres egne.

programme.title: NCIS: Topsikkert
programme.desc: En flådekommandør dør omboard på Air Force One. Agenter fra NCIS beslutter at tage undersøgelsen i egen hånd og tvinger også Secret Service Agent Kate Todd til at hjælpe.

programme.title: NCIS: Ladt i stikken
programme.desc: Under en træningsøvelse åbner en marines faldskærm ikke, og han styrter ned i en parkeret bil. NCIS-teamet ankommer til scenen og skal afgøre, om marinesoldatens død var et tilfælde eller et mord.

programme.title: NCIS: Søulk
programme.desc: Da en Navy commanders lig vasker op på land sammen med ligene af to narkokurerer, nægter Gibbs at tro, at den dræbte sømand var korrupt.

programme.title: NCIS: De Udødelige
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet undersøger, da en sømands lig findes på havets bund klædt i hvidt med et ceremonielt sværd. De opdager, at han var afhængig af et rollespil i stil med Wizards and Warriors.

programme.title: NCIS: Forbandelsen
programme.desc: En marineløjtnant , der blev meldt savnet for næsten ti år siden, er blevet fundet af en hjortejæger. Da NCIS-teamet ankommer til scenen for at efterforske, kan de se, at hans lig er blevet mumificeret.

programme.title: NCIS: Høj Sø
programme.desc: En NCIS-agent, der tidligere arbejdede under Gibbs, beder om teamets hjælp til at undersøge en sag, hvor sømænd på et hangarskib dør af en overdosis, men de havde ikke nogen historie om nogen form for stofmisbrug.

programme.title: NCIS: Ubåden Rosa
programme.desc: Et opløst lig opdages i et kar med syre på en flådebase og Ducky og Abby finder ud af, at offeret var en ubådsmand.

programme.title: NCIS: Mindste Sikkerhed
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet tager til Cuba for at efterforske en Navy-oversætters forbindelse til smugling på et interneringscenteer, efter at han pludselig dør bag rattet af sin bil, da han vender tilbage til USA fra Guantanamo Bay.

programme.title: NCIS: Faldet Marinesoldat
programme.desc: Efter at en enke efter en marinesoldat har modtaget et opkald fra sin døde mand, tager NCIS-teamet sagen og må gravet liget op for at udlede, om opkaldet var en spøg eller ej.

programme.title: NCIS: Levende Begravet
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet begravet i live kommer en kvinde ud af graven med hukommelsestab, og det eneste, hun husker, er, at der er en bombe om bord på et flådefartøj.

programme.title: NCIS: Spionøje
programme.desc: Da en flådekommandør som var en teknisk rådgiver for en civil underleverandører, der skabte en håndholdt sonarscanner, blev fundet død på stranden, efterforsker NCIS-teamet mordet ved hjælp af satellitteknologi.

programme.title: NCIS: Min Anden Venstre Fod
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet tilkaldes, da et afhugget ben med en tatovering for marinekorpset bliver fundet i en skraldespand. Det fører dem til en lille by, hvor der er en mordplan undervejs.

programme.title: NCIS: Et Skud, Et Drab

programme.title: 48 Hours: Shattered Dreams
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Chasing the Barefoot Bandit
programme.desc: A report on Colton Harris-Moore, also known as the “Barefoot Bandit,” because of his habit of committing crimes barefoot and leaving chalk outlines of his feet; and whose exploits included stealing planes, guns, yachts, and escaping to foreign countries.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Secrets, Lies and Alibis
programme.desc: John and Susan Sutton were sleeping in separate rooms in their Florida home, when a gunman entered their house and shot both of them several times. Susan was killed, but John survived. Nothing was taken from the house, proving the murder premeditated.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Long Island Serial Killer
programme.desc: A report on the disappearance of Shannan Gilbert, near Gilgo Beach, New York. The search for Shannan led to the discovery of a total of ten bodies in the scrub brush of Gilgo Beach, leading police to suspect the work of a serial killer.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Desperate Measures
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Live to Tell: Hunting Humans
programme.desc: In July 2007, Shea McDonough returned home and left the back door open for her brother, not knowing he wasn’t coming home for the night. Hours later, when her father went to her room to check on her, he saw a masked man standing over her with a knife.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: In November 2004, Peter and Joan Porco were attacked in their bed with an ax. Peter died at the scene. Joan survived and, although unable to speak because of her wounds, she nodded “yes” when a detective on the scene asked her if her son was the attacker.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Everything to Lose
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Every Picture Tells A Story
programme.desc: On February 15, 2009, Cathy McNaughton was stabbed to death in her home in Sharpsburg, Georgia. The day had started with her husband Alec serving her breakfast in bed.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Collision Course
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Usual Suspect
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Death Wish
programme.desc: A report surrounding the July 2009 death of Jeffrey Locker, whose body was found slumped over the steering wheel of his car in Harlem, New York. When authorities tracked Locker’s ATM card to Kenneth Minor, Minor said Locker had begged Minor to kill him.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Sweetheart Murders
programme.desc: The story of sweethearts Sabrina Gonsalves and John Riggins who were brutally murdered in Davis, California, in 1980. Initially, police suspected Gerald Gallego, but he was in jail at the time of the murders.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Year We Disappeared
programme.desc: In August 1979, John Busby, a Falmouth, Massachusetts police officer, was ambushed in his car by a gunman in a passing car who shot him in the face. Although wounded, Busby was able to write a note for police at the scene that said “Not an accident.”

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Stranger You Know
programme.desc: A report about Marti Hill, who was savagely beaten in her Prairie Village, Kansas home. She was found by police barely breathing and covered in blood.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Over the Edge
programme.desc: A report on the investigation into the 2009 disappearance of Dawn Viens, and why her husband, California chef David Viens, jumped off a cliff when he became a suspect in her disappearance.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Country Club Murders
programme.desc: A report on professional poker player Ernie Scherer III, the chief suspect in the 2008 murders of his parents, Charlene and Ernest, in their Castlewood Country Club home in Pleasanton, California.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Pain and Gain
programme.desc: A report about the crimes of the Sun Gym gang, a group of Miami, Florida drifters, petty thieves, and bodybuilders who kidnapped and killed wealthy people to fuel their lifestyle.

programme.title: 48 Hours: AKA Rockefeller
programme.desc: Authorities suspect a con man who has used many different identities may be a murderer.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Ambushed
programme.desc: A man helps a new detective figure out who murdered his father.

programme.desc: Fran's attempt to impress a handsome cantor at her mother's temple backfires when he's suddenly made the star in Maxwell's latest musical.

programme.title: The Nanny: Green Card
programme.desc: Maxwell is upset when Fran falls for Brighton's handsome French tutor.

programme.title: The Nanny: Ship Of Fran's
programme.desc: Maxwell arranges for everyone to join Fran on a Caribbean cruise.

programme.title: My Better Halves
programme.desc: Kriminalforfatteren Charles har skriveblokering. I jagten på inspiration beder han spiritisten Madame Arcati lave en seance. Det fører til mere end forventet, da Madame Arcati fremmaner genfærdet af Charles' kone, Elvira, der vil genoptage sit liv.

programme.title: Café Society
programme.desc: New York i 1930’erne. Bobby har brug for luftforandring og er desperat for at komme væk fra sine emsige forældre, sin gangsterbror og familiens juvelerforretning. Bobby beslutter sig for at prøve lykken i Hollywood.

programme.title: Can You Keep a Secret?
programme.desc: I den tro at de er ved at styrte ned, fortæller Emma alle sine hemmeligheder til en flot, men vildfremmed mand om bord på et fly. Det vil sige, hun troede, at han var fremmed… Filmen er baseret på bestsellerromanen af samme navn fra Sophie Kinsella.

programme.title: My Week with Marilyn
programme.desc: Marilyn Monroe er det forrige århundredes absolut største kvindelige ikon og er omgivet af en nærmest mytisk aura. Nu vækkes hun til live i 'My Week With Marilyn', der er baseret på virkelige hændelser.

programme.title: About Adam
programme.desc: Da den sorgløse Lucy (Hudson) møder den perfekte mand, Adam (Stuart Townsend), er hun parat til at opgive sit vilde liv og falde til ro. Men mens Lucy har travlt med at lægge bryllupsplaner, har Adam travlt med at charmere resten af hendes familie!

programme.title: About Hope
programme.desc: Thomas McKenzie har ledt efter den perfekte kvinde i hele sit liv. Da han møder to kvinder, som vækker hans interesse, går det op for ham, at den kærlighed, vi søger, ikke altid er den kærlighed, vi har brug for.

programme.title: Youth In Revolt
programme.desc: På en ferie møder den kiksede teenager Nick Twisp drømmepigen Sheeni. Nick, der ikke tidligere har haft held med piger, vil gøre alt for at vinde hendes hjerte og opfinder et alter-ego, den flamboyante og dristige Francois Dillinger.

programme.title: A Good Old Fashioned Orgy
programme.desc: 30-årige Eric og en gruppe gamle high school-venner holder hver sommer vilde fester i hans forældres strandhus. Da hans far planlægger at sælge huset, må Eric indse, at det er tid til at blive voksen. Der skal dog lige afholdes én sidste fest.

programme.title: Love at Mariposa Beach
programme.desc: En kvinde, der kæmper med problemer på sin arbejdsplads, tager fri for at besøge sin mor. På rejsen til sin hjemby reflekterer hun over livet, som leder hende til kærligheden.

programme.title: Teacher'S Pet
programme.desc: Clark Gable plays Jim Gannon, a school-of-hard-knocks newspaperman who despises journalism schools, until he sees who's doing the teaching.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Execution
programme.desc: Just before being hanged for shooting a man in the back, a man in 1880 is transported into the year 1959 by a professor who soon realizes that he has brought forward a savage killer.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Big Tall Wish
programme.desc: An over-the-hill boxer gets a boost from one of his biggest fans - a little boy with an unwavering belief in magic.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Nice Place to Visit
programme.desc: After being shot to death, Rocky Valentine encounters the amiable white-haired Mr. Pip, who gives Rocky everything he wishes for.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nightmare as a Child
programme.desc: Schoolteacher Helen Foley finds a strange and very serious little girl on the stairs outside her apartment. The little girl seems to know her and tries to jog her memory about a man she saw earlier that day. The man arrives at Helen's door…

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Stop at Willoughby
programme.desc: Riding home on the train one day, a man falls asleep and dreams it is 1880, and he is entering a small town called Willoughby.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Passage for Trumpet
programme.desc: A trumpet player who's convinced he'll never amount to anything attempts suicide and finds himself in a world where no one can hear or see him.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Bevis
programme.desc: An eccentric loser gets a new life from his guardian angel, but there is a price to keeping it.

programme.title: Prom Night III: The Last Kiss
programme.desc: Den ondsindede ånd Mary Lou Maloney vender tilbage til Hamilton High, hvor hun manipulerer en naiv mandlig elev til at hjælpe hende med at skabe kaos på skolen. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Prom Night 4: Deliver Us from Evil
programme.desc: Fire studerende dropper deres skolebal for at feste i et sommerhus. Men der er en psykotisk præst på fri fod, der er fast besluttet på at straffe syndere. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Apartment 1303
programme.desc: Sammen med sine venner fejrer Janet (Julianne Michelle) at hun er flyttet ind i sin nye lejlighed på 13. etage, men i løbet af aftenen springer hun uventet ud fra altanen og begår selvmord.

programme.title: A Haunted House
programme.desc: I denne skandaløse parodi på Paranormal Activity-filmene, The Devil Inside og andre found footage-film, hjemsøges et ungt par som netop er flyttet ind i deres drømmehus. Kort tid efter flytningen opdager de, at de ikke er alene.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: The Storyteller
programme.desc: In the early 20th century a young woman takes a job as a teacher in a one-room schoolhouse. One of her students, Mica, secretly takes extra books home to read.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: The Card
programme.desc: A compulsive spender accepts "The Card" to keep up her habit. Unfortunately stringent penalties kick in for late payments.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Shelter Skelter
programme.desc: A survivalist traps himself in his bomb shelter when a nuclear blast finally comes.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Song of the Younger World
programme.desc: In 1916 a girl and a young man from a reformatory for wayward boys fall in love and try to get away from her father, the superintendent. He finds out and doesn't approve of their love, locking away his daughter and punishing the boy.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Where is Everybody?
programme.desc: Mike Ferris finds himself in a town strangely devoid of people. But despite the emptiness, he has the odd feeling that he's being watched...

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: One for the Angels
programme.desc: A street salesman cleverly eludes Death. But if he lives, a little girl must die in his place.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Denton on Doomsday
programme.desc: A has-been, drunk gunslinger finds his fast-draw abilities magically restored.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Sixteen-Millimeter Shrine
programme.desc: An aging, former movie star lives and dreams in the past, constantly watching her old movies alone in her room.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Walking Distance
programme.desc: Martin Sloan, driving through the country, leaves his car and starts to walk toward his hometown, Homewood. He finds things exactly as they were when he was a child. He soon realizes he's gone back in time.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Escape Clause
programme.desc: A hypochondriac exchanges his soul for immortality and indestructibility.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Lonely
programme.desc: Corry is stranded on an asteroid after being convicted of a crime. He receives as a present a robot who looks, sounds, and acts like a real woman.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Time Enough at Last
programme.desc: A bank teller, Henry Bemis, longs for time alone to read books. He gets his wish...

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Perchance to Dream
programme.desc: A man is terrified of falling asleep for fear he might die.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader eksfangerne
programme.desc: Chris forsøger at hjælpe Malvo, en vaneforbryder, som lige er blevet løsladt fra fængslet, med at ændre sit liv ved at gå tilbage til high school.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Jordens dag
programme.desc: Chris skal finde på et skoleprojekt til Jordens dag, så han indsamler tomme dåser i den tro, at det vil blive en let opgave, som Julius kan hjælpe ham med.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader at være cool
programme.desc: Chris er på en mission for at blive en af de ”cool” børn og bliver taget med cigaretter og bortvist fra skolen.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader gallafesten i 9. klasse
programme.desc: Chris og Greg har ingen dates til gallafesten i 9. klasse, men så bliver Greg inviteret med, så Chris må gå alene. Miss Morello foreslår, at Chris inviterer den eneste pige, der ikke har en date endnu, Carrie White, og hun siger ja.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader mors dag
programme.desc: Chris vil købe en flaske dyr parfume til sin mor til mors dag for at takke hende for alt det, hun har gjort for ham.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader dimissionen
programme.desc: Chris’ glæde over at dimittere fra high school bliver ødelagt, da Greg meddeler, at han skal på en anden high school til efteråret.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Tattaglia
programme.desc: Som førsteårselev i high school glæder Chris sig til at gå i en skole, der har lidt mere mangfoldighed.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader kage
programme.desc: Chris siger ja til at hjælpe klassekammeraten Angel med at forbedre sine karakterer, hvis Angel vil hjælpe ham med at fange Chris’ nyeste flamme, Marias, opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Homecoming
programme.desc: Chris er i syvende himmel, da en sød pige, Jenise Huckstable, inviterer ham til Tattaglia Homecoming-festen.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader engelsklæreren
programme.desc: Da Julius og Rochelle hæver mr. Omars husleje, kræver han, at de renoverer lejligheden, og han flytter ind hos Chris’ familie, indtil reparationerne er færdige.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader min mand
programme.desc: Chris opdager, at når han hjælper skolens populære running back og hans venner med lektierne, så får han lov til at hænge ud med de cool børn.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Docs
programme.desc: Da Docs irriterende nye kæreste, Stacy, gør Chris’ liv til et helvede, beslutter Chris sig for at skille parret ad.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader sladrehanke
programme.desc: Selv om Chris bør være hjemme og passe Drew og Tonya, sniger han sig i biografen med sine venner og bliver vidne til en skudepisode ved biografen.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Big Bird
programme.desc: Chris er endelig begyndt at falde til på sin nye skole, da han bliver inviteret på date af skolens mest nørdede pige, Kelly, som alle kalder for ”Big Bird”.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader James
programme.desc: Julius indser, at han kan holde Rochelle lykkelig i ægteskabet ved at bruge gode råd fra ”The Oprah Winfrey Show”. Men desværre giver planen bagslag, da Rochelle tror, at Julius’ ændrede indstilling kommer på grund af en affære.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader nytårsaften
programme.desc: Chris er fast besluttet på at tilbringe nytårsaften på Times Square, men Rochelle siger, at Chris kun må tage af sted, hvis han finder en ansvarsfuld voksen at tage med.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader mr. Levine
programme.desc: Da Rochelle bestiller en kopi af sin fødselsattest, opdager hun, at hun er et år yngre, end hun troede, og hun begynder at leve sit liv med en ny og mere ungdommelig indstilling.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader sportsjakker
programme.desc: Chris og Greg melder sig til wrestlingholdet for at få en sportsjakke og imponere damerne.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader falsk id
programme.desc: Chris og Greg er nødt til at skaffe falsk id, ellers kan de ikke tage til en Fat Boys-koncert. Rochelle planlægger en surprisefest for Julius.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader egnethedsprøver
programme.desc: Chris ved, at han skal have høje point for at blive optaget på college og beslutter sig for at terpe til sin PSAT-prøve. Da Rochelle tvinger familien ud til et arrangement, har Chris ikke tid til at læse og vælger at købe svarene til prøven.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader boksning
programme.desc: Træner Thurman ser Chris blive mobbet af Caruso og foreslår ham at lære at bokse, så han kan forsvare sig selv.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader lasagne
programme.desc: Chris går modvilligt med til at opbevare noget pot for en forbryder på flugt, men han har svært ved at finde et gemmested, der ikke får ham i knibe.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader forårsferien
programme.desc: Chris kommer til at køre ind i Greg, da han prøvekører pedellens bil, og Greg ender på hospitalet med et brækket ben. Da begge Gregs forældre er ude at rejse, aflyser Rochelle familieferien, så hun kan passe Greg.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader bilen
programme.desc: Da Chris får sit kørekort, giver Rochelle og Julius ham lov til at købe en bil, men da bilen bliver stjålet og vandaliseret, indser Chris, hvor stort et ansvar det er at eje en bil.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader flabethed
programme.desc: Chris siger fra over for sin mor, Rochelle, og nægter at udføre sine huslige pligter, hvilket får Rochelle til at beklage sig til Julius over, at hendes søn er respektløs.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Tasha
programme.desc: Chris samler mod til at spørge Tasha, om hun vil være hans kæreste, og bliver overrasket, da hun siger ja. Men desværre vidste Chris ikke, at forholdet betyder, at han skal opgive al sin fritid og kun lave det, som Tasha har lyst til.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader bombetrusler
programme.desc: Som straf for Chris’ afbrydelse af historietimen får han og hans klassekammerater til opgave at lære en berømt tale fra 2. verdenskrig udenad og recitere den for hele klassen.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader eksamen
programme.desc: I skoleårets sidste uge får Chris at vide, at hvis han kommer for sent igen, så skal han gå året om.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader piloten
programme.desc: Da familien flytter til et nyt nabolag og en næsten helt hvid skole to timer væk fra de strenge og arbejdsomme forældre, kæmper Chris for at finde sit ståsted, mens han passer sine små søskende og prøver at håndtere skolens bølle, Joey.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Keisha
programme.desc: Da Chris’ mor, Rochelle, ansætter nabopigen, Keisha, til at hjælpe Drew med matematik, ser Chris det som den perfekte chance for at imponere hende. Men andre har muligvis samme plan.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader basketball
programme.desc: Chris melder sig til skolens baskethold, selv om han ikke kan spille, men en dumpet prøve truer med at få ham smidt af holdet. Derhjemme får Julius en ny lejer, som tilbyder at betale et halvt års husleje, selv om han gør Rochelle nervøs.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader pølse
programme.desc: Da Julius køber en stor kasse pølser, tvinger han alle til at spise det til alle måltider. Men det nægter Tonya, og det skaber spændinger mellem hende og Rochelle.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Fede Mike
programme.desc: Chris lader et af børnene fra nabolaget låne sin cykel, selv om Julius advarer ham mod det, og drengen stjæler den.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader halloween
programme.desc: Det er halloween, og Chris bliver ellevild, da en pige inviterer ham til kostumefest. Men Caruso har planer med ham …

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader babysitteren
programme.desc: Da Julius og Rochelle holder dateaften, hyrer de en babysitter. Men Chris bliver nødt til at tage over, da hun er nødt til at gå for at tage sig af noget.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader møntvaskeriet
programme.desc: Mens Julius og Rochelle tager ud for at købe nyt tv, skal Chris have sine søskende med på møntvaskeri. Men det hele går galt, da Tonya stormer ud.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader madkuponer
programme.desc: Julius finder 200 dollar i madkuponer, men Rochelle er for flov til at vise dem til Sheila, så hun begynder at bruge af opsparingen, da hun handler ind.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Greg
programme.desc: Chris og Greg bliver uvenner, da de bryder ”ingen computerspil”-reglen hjemme hos Greg efter skole. Hjemme hos familien Rock savner Tonya Chris, fordi hun ikke kan give ham skylden for alt.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader jul
programme.desc: Det er jul, og Julius og Rochelle har svært ved at fortælle familien, at de ikke har råd til gaver, fordi vandvarmeren er i stykker. Chris bliver overrasket, da han finder ud af, hvem madindsamlingen går til.

programme.title: Scorpion: Sly and the Family Stone
programme.desc: Team Scorpion rejser til Irland for at fejre Megans mindehøjtidelighed, og Walter opdager, at en naturkatastrofe i en nærliggende sø har skabt en giftig sky, der potentielt kan dræbe alle i landsbyen.

programme.title: Scorpion: Mother Load
programme.desc: Paiges fraværende mor tilkalder Team Scorpion, da hun ved et tilfælde opdager en glemt atomreaktor, der er på nippet til at eksplodere.

programme.title: Scorpion: This Is the Pits
programme.desc: Walter er nødt til at svømme gennem de livsfarlige La Brea-tjæregrave, da Team Scorpion hjælper en kvinde, der er fanget i tjæren. Nu skal han bare nå frem, inden hun løber tør for ilt.

programme.title: Scorpion: Wreck the Halls
programme.desc: Det er juleaften, og Team Scorpions elektronikfrie juletur bliver livsfarlig, da de støder på våbenhandlere, og Ralph bliver kidnappet, da de forsøger at flygte.

programme.title: Scorpion: Ice Ca-Cabes
programme.desc: Da en mission i ørkenen resulterer i eksploderende granatsplinter, der sårer Cabe alvorligt, må Team Scorpion fryse hans krop ned for at redde hans liv.

programme.title: Scorpion: Faux Money Maux Problems
programme.desc: Da Team Scorpion bliver narret til at producere falske penge for en udenlandsk virksomhed, der har til hensigt at ødelægge den amerikanske økonomi, må Paiges mor Veronicas evner redde dem.

programme.title: Scorpion: The Hole Truth
programme.desc: Team Scorpion skal redde en mand, der står på kanten af et enormt synkehul, der truer med at ødelægge Los Angeles' vandforsyning for altid.

programme.title: Scorpion: Sharknerdo
programme.desc: Team Scorpions mission om at finde en sunken skat går galt, da Walter og Paiges båd eksploderer og efterlader dem fortabt midt i Stillehavet, omgivet af hajer.

programme.title: Scorpion: Keep It in Check, Mate
programme.desc: Walter og Sylvester deltager undercover i en international skakkonkurrence i udlandet for at befri en amerikansk spion, før hendes identitet bliver afsløret.

programme.title: Scorpion: Dirty Seeds, Done Dirt Cheap
programme.desc: En simpel mission, der skal beskytte en vigtig frøbank, går galt, så Team Scorpion må redde Happy, Sylvester og Cabe, som begynder at lide af livstruende, frygtbaserede hallucinationer.

programme.title: Scorpion: Don't Burst My Bubble
programme.desc: Efter en voldsom storm bliver Happys veninde Ada, der lever i en steril boble for at beskytte sit svækkede immunsystem, efterladt med farligt affald, der er på nippet til at trænge igennem beskyttelsen.

programme.title: Scorpion: Monkey See, Monkey Poo
programme.desc: Team Scorpion skal finde en sjælden, truet abe i Amazonas, som har antistoffet til at kurere en farlig virus. Toby og Happy går desuden til en ægteskabsrådgiver.

programme.title: Scorpion: Broken Wind
programme.desc: Team Scorpion er på en mission for at reparere en vindmølle i en vindmøllepark og må skynde sig at redde Paige og Happy, før kablet, der holder gondolen, de befinder sig i, knækker.

programme.title: Scorpion: Rock Block
programme.desc: Team Scorpion må trodse en udenlandsk regerings ordrer, efter at de har hentet en asteroide fra rummet, der indeholder DNA-strenge, som kan få dødelige konsekvenser.

programme.title: Scorpion: Strife on Mars
programme.desc: Team Scorpion bliver fanget i en fejlslagen og farlig biodom, der er designet til Mars, mens de forsøger at få et par videnskabsfolk ud derfra.

programme.title: Scorpion: Something Burrowed, Something Blew
programme.desc: Efter at en simpel opgave med at slukke en tunnelbrand ender katastrofalt, må Team Scorpion hjælpe Toby og Happy med at nå frem til alteret og blive lykkeligt gift.

programme.title: Scorpion: Maroon 8
programme.desc: Mens de er på vej til Toby og Happys bryllupsrejse, styrter Team Scorpions fly ned på en øde ø – de har hverken mange forsyninger eller meget håb om at blive reddet.

programme.title: Scorpion: Scorp Family Robinson
programme.desc: Spændingerne går højt hos Team Scorpion tre uger efter at være styrtet ned på en øde ø, hvor de må kæmpe for at overvinde deres indbyrdes udfordringer for at blive reddet.

programme.title: Scorpion: Extinction
programme.desc: Team Scorpion må samarbejde med deres gamle fjende Mark Collins for at forhindre menneskehedens udryddelse. Derudover navigerer Walter og Paige akavet rundt i deres nye forhold.

programme.title: Scorpion: More Extinction
programme.desc: Team Scorpion arbejder fortsat sammen med deres nemesis, Mark Collins, for at forhindre en hændelse, der kan udrydde menneskeheden. Cabes last minute-beslutning kan føre til en ende på hans karriere.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: En ny epoke i Ekspeditionen nærmer sig, og hold syd kæmper for at opnå en sejr, inden holdene opløses.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Det er tid til sammenlægning, men først skal deltagerne igennem et skæbnesvangert Øråd, hvor intet er som det plejer. Bølgerne går højt, når endnu en deltager må forlade ekspeditionen.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Pete og Alexandra er havnet i midten af to alliancer, og de står overfor en stor beslutning. Der skal bekendes kulør, og endnu en overlever får slukket deres drøm.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: To af overleverne begiver sig ud i en ikonisk duel, der kan have store konsekvenser for deres chancer i dysten, og et stort skænderi skaber dårlig stemning op til Ørådet.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Hierakiet på stranden bliver tydeliggjort, når der skal fordeles pengeposer til auktionen, og ikke alle er lige tilfredse.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Jakob Kjeldbjerg åbner Robinson Ekspeditionen med kompromisløs autoritet, når deltagerne fra start skal træffe svære fravalg af hinanden inden den første holdkonkurrence.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Efter blot få dage på stranden skal det tabende hold i Dysten beslutte, hvem der bliver den første til at forlade Robinson Ekspeditionen 2026.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Overleverne skal endnu engang træffe svære fravalg, når en fra hvert hold sendes til Forhandling. Forhandlingen får store konsekvenser for to af Ekspeditionens deltagere.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: I ni dage har overleverne kun levet af den sparsomme kost, de selv har kunnet fange i den vilde natur. Derfor er motivationen stor i Striden, når den første madpræmie er på spil.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: I Striden kæmper holdene om en lækker frugtkurv. Men sejrens sødme overskygges af dramatiske hændelser, der får stor betydning for flere af ekspeditionens overlevere.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Med blot 4 overlevere tilbage på Hold Syd, ryster Jakob Kjeldbjerg posen, når de to hold kæmper om en hemmelighedsfuld kiste. Kisten får store konsekvenser for både Nord- og Sydboerne.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 304
programme.desc: Pernille og Nicklas fra Odense bor så småt, at hvis man skal have lidt privatliv, er der kun toilettet at ty til. Nicklas drømmer om få et køkken med mange blus og to ovne, så han kan lave mere mad.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 305
programme.desc: Wendy og Jesper fra Kalundborg bor i forvejen godt i en lejlighed, der har en formidabel udsigt, men en kommende familieforøgelse gør, at de skal finde noget der er større.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 306
programme.desc: Jonas og Louise bliver rystede, da de ser hvilket hus de har råd til. Mads Mikkelsen og Tobias Edlev Nielsen er denne gang kommet på overarbejde for at prøve at imødekomme parrets ønsker.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 307
programme.desc: Mads og Mia vil gerne flytte udenfor byen – men ikke helt på landet. Med Tobias og Mads´ hjælp køber de en bolig, der har lige nøjagtig alt det, de ikke bryder sig om.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 401
programme.desc: Boligkøb i blinde er tilbage, og i sæsonpremieren møder vi Tine og Lars, som har svimlende otte millioner at købe hus og renovere for. Det store budget har dog ikke hjulpet dem hidtil – kan eksperterne?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 402
programme.desc: Boligkøb i blindes eksperter kommer på arbejde i Hørning, hvor præsten og hendes familie bor til leje i et rækkehus og gerne vil videre – men bliver skræmte af tilstandsrapporter og spidse tage.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 404
programme.desc: Ida og Rasmus drømmer om at skifte deres 60 kvm lejebolig på Nørrebro ud med en murermestervilla i Hillerød. Men de fortryder bittert, at de lod eksperterne hjælpe, da de ser det hus, pengene rakte til.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 405
programme.desc: Anna Thora og Jonas har to små børn – og en drøm om at flytte sammen med bedsteforældrene. Så eksperterne skal på jagt efter et hus, der kan rumme to familier, med plads til alle og deres behov.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 406
programme.desc: Anne Sofie og Paw har ikke plads nok i den lille Frederiksberg-lejlighed efter familieforøgning. Men kravene til drømmehuset er tårnhøje, så selv med 7 millioner til køb, kan de ikke finde det rigtige.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 501
programme.desc: Louise og Jonas fra Viborg drømmer stort, men drømmen falder til jorden med et brag. Eksperterne kommer på ekstraarbejde, før det – forhåbentlig – ender med, at den lille familie flytter ind i drømmehuset.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 502
programme.desc: Anita og Martins to børn har overtaget hjemmet, og der er legetøj overalt. Løsningen er en større bolig, men det er ikke lykkedes parret at finde det rigtige hus. Nu går eksperterne i gang, men det bliver ikke nemt.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 503
programme.desc: Tina og Danni solgte deres rækkehus i troen på, at de nok hurtigt ville finde det rette hus. Men nej. Parret er superkræsne, og har høje krav. Kan eksperterne skabe det hjem, Tina og Danni drømmer om?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 504
programme.desc: Laura og Jesper og Jespers to børn bor til leje i Humlebæk, og det er de mildest talt trætte af. De mangler plads, have – og de vil også gerne have børn sammen snart. Men to års boligjagt har ikke givet bonus.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 505
programme.desc: Ulla og Kristian bor i en smuk herskabslejlighed på Frederiksberg med deres to børn. Men de ønsker sig mere plads i et børnevenligt kvarter i cykelafstand til indre by. Kan Tobias Edlev-Nielsen finde et hus til dem?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 506
programme.desc: En lille lejebolig i Vanløse og to små børn – det er ikke det bedste match. Lisa og Erling drømmer om et stort hus med stor have. Tobias kommer på hårdt arbejde, for drømmene er en hel del større end budgettet.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Skåne
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor explores his own backyard of Skåne and hometown of Malmö, a multi cultural food mix. Here you can find food and culture from all over the world that makes it a unique culinary destination.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Läckö & Kinnekulle
programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Forår, sommer, efterår, vinter ... og forår
programme.desc: I en flydende eremitbolig midt i den koreanske vildmark guider en gammel munk en dreng gennem livets faser. Da drengen konfronteres med begær og vold, sættes hans visdom på prøve. En poetisk fortælling om balance, livscyklus og menneskelig indsigt.

programme.title: Jeg hedder stadig Trinity
